name: DAM (design asset manager)
what: Owner-built, read-only design library behind a local MCP server: design systems with a DESIGN.md and a tokens.json each, self-contained HTML and React components, cover images, principle documents and idea cards. It generates nothing.
install: Private repository: needs a DAM checkout on the same machine. Run npm ci in the checkout once. Then add a stdio server named dam to the project's .mcp.json: command <DAM checkout>/node_modules/.bin/tsx, args [<DAM checkout>/scripts/mcp/server.ts], plus --owner for owner mode. Use absolute paths.
firstCall: none (no init call). Call list_facets before a style or pattern filter. In owner mode call list_principles, then get_principles, before design work in a discipline.
evidenceNote: Read from a repository checkout: the MCP server source, the collection manifest and the docs. The server was not connected and could not start (dependencies not installed). No live tools/list and no tool call ran. Item totals come from a manifest dated 2026-11-09 and disagree with the repository docs.
